rag.text:
Test: TC-4746 — Global - Workload Plans - Multiselect in assigned resources in Workload Plan
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-39 Global - Workload plans
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Administration -> Resources -> Workload plans tab
   Expected: Workload plans tab is displayed
2. Click on workloadPlanName
   Data: workloadPlanName: TC-4756
   Expected: Details of workload plan TC-4756 are displayed
3. Click on 'Assigned resources' button
   Expected: List of users is empty
4. Click on selector and type userName in search bar
   Data: userName: TC-4756
   Expected: List of following users is displayed:

* TC-4756A
* TC-4756B
* TC-4756C

Checkboxes are displayed next to userNames

'Select all' and 'Deselect all' are displayed above list of users
5. Click 'Select all' and click outside of selector
   Expected: Checkboxes next userNames are ticked

In the selector button there are 2 userNames: TC-4756A and TC-4... and 'X' button next to userName and +1 icon
6. Select startDate and click Plus button and then assign
   Data: startDate: 01/Jul/24
   Expected: Users: TC-4756A, TC-4756B and TC-4756C are added to the list of assigned resources
7. Click on selector and type userName in search bar
   Data: userName: TC-4756
   Expected: List of following users is displayed:

* TC-4756A
* TC-4756B
* TC-4756C

Checkboxes are displayed next to userNames

'Select all' and 'Deselect all' are displayed above list of users
8. Select userName, startDate date and click Plus button to assign
   Data: userName: TC-4756A

startDate: 15/Jul/24
   Expected: New period is added for user TC-4756A

Following list is displayed:

TC-4756A with efficiency 1 and two periods:

* Period 1 starts at 01/Jul/24
* Period 2 starts at 15/Jul/24

TC-4756B with efficiency 1 and start date 01/Jul/24

TC-4756C with efficiency 1 and start date 01/Jul/24
